simple.summary: אוּפָז (ʼÛwphâz) means Uphaz , a famous gold region First listed occurrence: Dan 10 5.

definitions.full: H210. Uphaz אוּפָז ( proper name, of a location unknown & dubious) whence came gold, מֵא ׳זָהָב Jer 10:9 ; א ׳ֶכּתֶם Dan 10:5 ; so Thes 1Kin 10:18 מוּפָז זָהָב ( מוּפָז = ׳מֵא ); but ᵐ5 δόκιμος , & 2Chr 9:17 טָהוֺר , whence MV Klo make מוּפָז Hoph`al Participle from פזז q. v. Klo reads אוֺפִיר (q. v.) for אוּפָז Jer 10:9 ; Dan 10:5 , in view of אוֺפִיר כֶּתֶם Isa 13:12 . **Corrupt, see Siegf ThLz, Nov. 7, 1883, 530 ; he explained ׳מֵא Jer 10:9 as error for מוּפָז 1Kin 10:18 , and ׳א Dan 10:5 as borrowed from Jer 10:9 ; in 10:9 Gie reads מֵאוֺפִיר , Du either this or מוּפָז (see פזז ); read מֵאוֺפִיר perhaps also Dan 10:5 (Dr).
